name: The kit registry in the browser: window.__jfkit lists every plugin whose script tag is on the page, all with the same kit version, which is the version and kit version each plugin's GET /<Route>/Admin/Diagnostics reports; and the console shows no error or warning from our scripts (probes/console-probe.js: a ClientScript or AdminScript frame, or a [<Plugin>] or [<prefix>] message) on the login page, Home, a details page with the editor, the player with its bookmarks list and Bookmarks' settings page on the dashboard. As admin, on Long Test Movie; bookmarks unchanged.

steps.name: sign in as admin (the login page runs our scripts signed out first)
our script tags on the page, each with its kit registered
steps.waitFor: (() => { const tags = [...document.querySelectorAll('script')].map(s => [...s.attributes].map(a => a.name).find(n => /^data-jf[a-z]+-plugin$/.test(n))).filter(Boolean).map(n => n.slice(5, -7)); const reg = window.__jfkit || {}; if (!tags.length || !tags.every(p => reg[p] && reg[p].kit)) return false; const routes = {}; [...document.querySelectorAll('script')].forEach(s => { const n = [...s.attributes].map(a => a.name).find(x => /^data-jf[a-z]+-plugin$/.test(x)); const m = /[.][.][/]([A-Za-z]+)[/]ClientScript/.exec(s.getAttribute('src') || ''); if (n && m) routes[n.slice(5, -7)] = m[1]; }); return { tags, routes, kits: Object.keys(reg).map(p => ({ prefix: p, plugin: reg[p].plugin, version: reg[p].version, kit: reg[p].kit })) }; })()

steps.name: window.__jfkit lists exactly the plugins with a tag, all with the same kit version
steps.message: a plugin's kit is missing from window.__jfkit, or the kit versions differ

steps.name: each plugin's Diagnostics (server side, at the route its tag's src names: User Ratings is UserRatings): its version and kit version
steps.eval: Promise.all(__vars.registry.kits.map(async k => { const d = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl(__vars.registry.routes[k.prefix] + '/Admin/Diagnostics')); return { prefix: k.prefix, plugin: k.plugin, client: { version: k.version, kit: k.kit }, server: { version: d.PluginVersion, kit: d.KitVersion } }; }))

steps.name: the browser runs the build the server has: same plugin and kit versions
steps.message: a plugin's script and its server report different versions

steps.name: find Long Test Movie
steps.eval: (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Long Test Movie', Limit: 1 })).Items[0].Id
